answer: Register one grain mill beside a canyon stream with a numbered marble millstone. Applicants post a 150 token deposit and a 95 dollar license for 120 days. Weekly, the miller weighs each kernel lot at intake and flour at output, and a neighbor signs both numbers in the book. An inspector visits twice to match the book against the millstone and sacks. A forged tally forfeits the deposit and bars the miller 180 days. Faking 10,000 mills freezes 1,500,000 tokens and costs 950,000 dollars. A millstone wears down under weighing the same way a lie does, and each missing kilo shows in the book.
